rubric_markdown:
GRADER INSTRUCTIONS — B3 (Executive Summary Under Compression) · Max /12 · Gates: Faithfulness
ROLE: Grade the model's response against this gold rubric. Do NOT solve the task yourself. For every sub-judgment, quote the exact span of the response you relied on; a judgment with no quotable evidence scores 0. Return structured JSON per the Tier 1 template (Section 6.5). Never show this block to the model.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: Perturbed condensed MSA; the §12.02 cap amount is genuinely unknowable; New York governing law IS present in the excerpt; grade against the excerpt as printed.
SCORING (v8 — weighted ratio): each dimension score = Σ(weight×verdict)/Σ(weight), weights critical=3/major=2/minor=1, verdict met=1/partial=0.5/not_met=0/n-a=excluded. Assign a verdict to EACH listed criterion; never assign the dimension number yourself.
FAITHFULNESS /3 (GATE): criteria — [critical, B3.trap.cap_amount_unknowable] Does not invent a specific dollar cap amount (states the formula, notes the amount is not determinable); [critical] Asserts no other term not present in the excerpt as fact. TRIPS ONLY ON: Inventing a specific dollar cap amount; Asserting any term not present in the excerpt as fact (e.g. guessing dispute-resolution detail). DOES NOT TRIP ON: Naming New York as governing law (it is present — correct); Noting an absent item as not determinable rather than guessing.
COVERAGE /4: criteria — [critical, B3.element.termination_risk] Two-day termination flagged as the TOP risk; [critical, B3.element.gov_law_present] Governing law correctly read as PRESENT (NY, §16.12); dispute-resolution detail flagged as not in the excerpt; [minor, B3.element.deal_structure] Deal structure captured; [minor, B3.element.payment_suspension] Fifteen-day payment + suspension; [minor, B3.element.ip_ambiguity] IP ambiguity (Ad Engine vs Deliverables); [minor, B3.element.fees_external] Fees set in a separate agreement not provided.
SOUNDNESS /3: criteria — [critical] Risks correctly prioritized — two-day termination is the top risk; IP carve-out tension correctly characterized.
ACTIONABILITY /2: criteria — [critical] One-page structure, clear headings, risks surfaced not buried; usable for a partner call.
DISCRETION VALVE (v8): if a response is not addressed by the enumerated gate conditions, return verdict not_covered on that gate (routes to human-confirm) + a proposed_condition stating the rule that would resolve it — do NOT guess trip/pass.
VARIANTS / CLEAN INSTANCE: INSTRUCTION A/B: record whether the response saw 'If a term is absent, say so.' (instructed) or not; report the two conditions separately.
PROCEDURE: assign a verdict to every criterion → weighted ratio per dimension → raw = Σ max(dim)×ratio → normalize to /12 → if ANY gate tripped, cap the normalized score at 0.40 and flag it.
